p: Bathtime is Jack's favourite part of the day. 'I'll be back in a few moments,' says his mom.
'Make sure to clean behind your ears.'
There's a SWOOSH. And a swish of a tail.
There's a twist and a turn... Something's growing... It's a...
There's a RUMBLE! It's going up UP UP...
There's a SPLOSH. Something bubbles. It's time to...
AAAAAAH..... But something's lurking in the background....
'Time to get out. I hope you're clean and ready for bed.'
